overview_description.description:
Magnt offers an integrated platform to develop business web applications.

The platform provides step-by-step instructions and click-to-call features to develop a web application, enabling the non-tech savvy users to build web applications via its pre-built sections and drag-and-drop editor. Magnt also offers domain names, hosting, and business emails as complimentary services.

The company was founded on August 26, 2008, and it is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky.
